records.name: Alloy Plate
records.des: The most common anti-collision device. Capable of knocking away most debris.

records.name: High-Beam Headlight
records.des: Headlights that even train robbers fear.

records.name: Loud Speaker (440Hz)
records.des: Causes people who hear it to be on edge. Might attract enemies.

records.name: Cactus Juice Coating
records.des: A coating made of cactus juice. The Marauders have a superstition that cacti can dispel Morphic Field Pollution, which has been proven effective to some extent.

records.name: Sheet Metal Armor
records.des: Wasteland-style. Simple but also useful.

records.name: Harmony Wrecker
records.des: Artificially creates short-range Morphic Field Pollution to corrode reality's constitution and render explosives ineffective, then shovels them away from the railway tracks.

records.name: Roller Device
records.des: Invented by someone who was tired of waiting for the uneven roads to be fixed.

records.name: Hydraulic Fork
records.des: While on the railway, some things can't be combatted with force, such as oil tanks and barrel bombs. This modification will be able to shovel these things away from the tracks.

records.name: Crushing Roller
records.des: If one saw blade doesn't work, how about an entire row?

records.name: Decomponent Roller
records.des: Artificially creates short-range Morphic Field Pollution to corrode reality's constitution and weaken physical matters, then rolls over them at once.

records.name: Wrecker Saw
records.des: A commonly used obstacle-clearing device that can even saw open rocks.

records.name: Chaos Ram
records.des: Made from the hard parts of Chaos Remains to ram Chaos Remains. The literal representation of an eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.

records.name: Screeching Shovel
records.des: Made from the sharpest claws and hardest bones of Chaos Remains. Screeches when the train is on the move. Just this sound alone is enough to drive away ordinary Chaos Remains.

records.name: Fine Steel Drill
records.des: There was a theory that an immense, unknown energy would be generated when a drill bit spins, which led to the creation of this massive drill bit. However, this energy did not present itself, so the drill bit is now used as a regular obstacle-clearing device.

records.name: Thermal Drill
records.des: Obtains immense heat by using Chaos Remains as the raw material, then directs the heat in one spot to form a drill bit that will drill through anything.

records.name: Laser Drill
records.des: A Laser Drill originally used for mining but was, for some crazy reason, installed on the train. Intimidates all enemies who attempt to block the train's paths.

records.name: Powerful Spark Plug
records.des: Optimizes the ignition function, thus boosting the Rapid Bullet's conversion efficiency.

records.name: Bulletease
records.des: Optimizes the conversion efficiency and maximum capacity of the Rapid Bullet's Morphic Resonance.

records.name: Explosive Spark Plug
records.des: Adds nitrous oxide to the gas produced by the Rapid Bullet to boost its burning rate, thus increasing the train speed.

records.name: Flashpoint Generator
records.des: Nicola's masterpiece. Makes use of the train engine's Overload Core to amplify the Rapid Bullet's Morphic Resonance, which transforms the train into "lightning."

Getway.DisplayName: Anita Energy Institute - Energy Tech Center

records.name: Racing Box
records.des: What's the point of arming the train? Speed is what's of utmost importance. This modification directs all the power to the engine instead of the weapon system.

Getway.DisplayName: Base Yunxiu Bridge - Yunxiu Bridge Armory

records.name: Transport Drone 727
records.des: A drone from the ANITA "Prime" series designed for freight transportation, capable of retrieving dropped goods back to the train. \nThis equipment is [train weapon] and can be equipped in the train menu.

records.name: Transport Drone 757
records.des: A drone from the ANITA "Prime" series designed for freight transportation, capable of retrieving dropped goods back to the train. Upgraded power and endurance allow it to transport heavier goods over longer distances.

Getway.DisplayName: Anita Energy Institute - Energy Tech Center

records.name: Transport Drone 787
records.des: A drone from the ANITA "Prime" series, Gardener model, designed for freight transportation and capable of stable operation in various harsh environments and morphic field pollution areas. It has powerful propulsion and long endurance but comes with a high cost. Owners would feel devastated if it crashes.

Getway.DisplayName: Anita Weapon Factory - Warfare Tech Center

records.name: Drone Array 797
records.des: A drone identified as one of the ANITA "Prime" series, but the model has never existed. It was transported from an unknown location by a fault space positioning anchor named "Space Tangent." Its techonology and performance are far more advanced than other models in the series.\nThis equipment is [train weapon] and can be equipped in the train menu.

records.name: Recon Drone 313
records.des: The basic model drone from the ANITA "Prime" series.\nThis equipment is [train weapon] and can be equipped in the train menu.

records.name: Recon Drone 353
records.des: An upgraded version of the ANITA "Prime" series drone with increased power, allowing it to scout over longer distances.

Getway.DisplayName: Anita Energy Institute - Energy Tech Center

records.name: Recon Drone 373
records.des: A drone from the ANITA "Prime" series, Gardener model, capable of stable operation in various harsh environments and morphic field pollution areas. It comes with a high cost, and owners would feel devastated if it crashes.

Getway.DisplayName: Anita Weapon Factory - Warfare Tech Center

records.name: Repair Robot 919
records.des: A robot of Anita's "Prime" series products that can automatically repair the train. Equipped with repair tools and artificial intelligence.

records.name: Repair Robot 929
records.des: A robot of Anita's "Prime" series products that can automatically repair the train. Equipped with repair tools and artificial intelligence.

records.name: High Torque Motor
records.des: Uses thicker coils to substantially increase the train's acceleration function.

records.name: Booster Rocket
records.des: An additionally installed rocket thruster that boosts train speed.

Getway.DisplayName: Anita Launch Center - Launch Tech Center

records.name: Fusion Acceleration Module
records.des: A type of enhancement device for propulsion rockets. Directly converts Heavy Chaos Stones into Helium-3, and during the mass-energy conversion, the Helium-3 produced will bring about a nuclear fusion reaction under high temperature and pressure. However, as it involves techniques prohibited by the Citadel, it's classified as contraband.

records.name: ANITA Transfer Protocol
records.des: A communication protocol to communicate with Suspension Point Base. Can teleport you a certain distance away via Suspension Point Base's teleportation device.

records.name: Gravitational Propulsion Module
records.des: Directly converts large amounts of Chaos Stones into a Planck-scale electrically neutral Kerr black hole that rotates at high speed. This will compress the space ahead of the train, which propels it forward. It's one of the technologies that Anita believes is viable for intergalactic travel. However, the Morphic Field catalyst will lose its effectiveness upon being polluted by Chaos Stones, so it can only work in a limited range.

records.name: Featherfall Rune
records.des: An arcane item created by Empire Commercial Magic Academy. Whoever possesses it will be light on their feet. Hanging it on trains seems to be an option too.

records.name: Haste Rune
records.des: An arcane item created by Empire Commercial Magic Academy. Worked wonders when it was used on horses. Surprisingly, it also works when hung on trains.

records.name: Cargo Rack
records.des: Secures cargo even better and increases the amount of cargo that the train can safely transport.

records.name: Space Anomaly Generator
records.des: A device that produces Morphic Field Pollution on its own, generating an anomalous space in the cargo hold to carry more cargo or to transport prohibited goods under B.C.R.L.'s radar. It's classified as a dangerous techonology by the Citadel and is hence banned from use.

records.name: Camel Emblem
records.des: An arcane item created by Empire Commercial Magic Academy. Can effectively increase livestock's physical strength. Seems to work on trains as well, albeit you'd definitely need more than one.

records.name: Luna Emblem
records.des: An emblem with the power of Arthu King, a basal Chaos Remain reportedly friendly to humans. Protects the humans in dangerous zones.

records.name: Tower Emblem
records.des: An emblem with the power of Seprasoda, a basal Chaos Remain. Capable of restoring damaged objects.

records.name: Repelling Headlight
records.des: Special headlights invented to specifically affect Chaos Remains' photoreceptors. Able to repel Chaos Remains to some extent but completely useless on Chaos Remains without photoreceptors.

Getway.DisplayName: Anita Energy Institute - Energy Tech Center

records.name: Morphic Lure
records.des: Special headlights invented to specifically affect Chaos Remains' photoreceptors. Able to attract Chaos Remains to some extent but completely useless on Chaos Remains without photoreceptors.

Getway.DisplayName: Anita Weapon Factory - Warfare Tech Center

records.name: Floating Star Light
records.des: Adapted from Chaos Remains' organs. Conjures a floating ball of light surrounding the train that causes burns when touched.

Getway.DisplayName: Anita Weapon Factory - Warfare Tech Center

records.name: Nine Yin Lit
records.des: A treasure gifted to Night Chains by Dracanaru, a basal Chaos Remain. Illuminates the passage to the Chaos World. It is likely the reason that Night Chains is able to travel everywhere safely. The user can roam in the intermundium to escape the dangers of the two worlds.

records.name: SonicVortex (432Hz)
records.des: Its mellifluous frequency is said to be able to resonate with the universe, making people feel harmonized, so much so that some enemies will let you off.

Getway.DisplayName: Anita Weapon Factory - Warfare Tech Center

records.name: Infrasound Oscillator
records.des: Makes acoustic resonance occur in Chaos Remains, then have them crash into the atmosphere composed of the planet's Morphic Field at full tilt. This will result in the Chaos Remains' Morphic Field being corroded by the planet's Morphic Field, hence repelling the Chaos Remains. However, it might have an adverse effect if used in places with severe Morphic Field Pollution.

Getway.DisplayName: Anita Weapon Factory - Warfare Tech Center

records.name: Ruckus & Roll
records.des: The world's loudest sound system manufactured by Night Chains. Nothing else worth mentioning other than its incredibly loud sound. Once it's turned on, all robbers will run toward you, and those fired-up people will be a great help to you in eliminating tons of Chaos Remains.

records.name: Voice of Folly
records.des: The mutter of Rama Doo, a basal Chaos Remain committed to destroying the world. Swiped and recorded in dreamland by the Empire sage, Randalf. The voice itself already embodies destruction. Enhances anything with the concept of "destruction" within its effective range.

records.name: Morphic Resonance Coating
records.des: Circulates the Morphic Resonance of Morphic Field Stabilizers on vehicles through a coating. Highly effective in protecting against Morphic Field Pollution.

Getway.DisplayName: Anita Energy Institute - Energy Tech Center

records.name: Racing King Coating
records.des: The color that represents high speed among train robbers. Seems to actually increase speed once used.

records.name: Titanium Nitride Coating
records.des: Has exceedingly high hardness and erosion resistance and is fairly good at protecting against Morphic Field Pollution as well. But most importantly, it can turn your train so shiny as if it were gold-plated.

records.name: Punk Heavy Metal
records.des: Iconic paint job of Rock 'n' Roll trains. The Marauders, vagrants, and even robbers will be in awe of you, and most of them will no longer attack you. On top of that, it truly does contain rare metal, making it pretty practical.

records.name: URO Coating
records.des: A type of coating made from Chaos Remains that makes your train appear phantom-like, thereby transforming it into an unidentified railway object. Superstitious Marauders and robbers will then regard your train as the ghost train of urban legends and thus dare not approach.

Getway.DisplayName: Anita Launch Center - Launch Tech Center

records.name: Hanging Harness
records.des: It's inevitable that trains working the busiest routes will have to sell hanging tickets at times.

records.name: Military Train Armor
records.des: B.C.R.L.-developed armor plate specifically for trains. Even though it hasn't been upgraded to protect against the attack of energy weapons and Chaos Remains, it's still popular due to its ample supply and how easy it is to manufacture.

records.name: Ceramic Armor
records.des: Initially designed to be used on spacecraft for heat insulation. Lightweight and great at insulating against heat.

Getway.DisplayName: Anita Launch Center - Launch Tech Center

records.name: Chaos Remain Armor
records.des: An armor made from the carcass of large Chaos Remains above the Blazesun Class. Common Chaos Remains will see you as one of its own or a predator, therefore steering clear of you. At the same time, it's also excellent as protection.

records.name: Construct No.5
records.des: A supermaterial created by the Citadel that Earth Union scientists can't make sense of. Virtually indestructible once it takes shape. It is supposedly what was used to construct Senanonic.

records.name: Racing Box Pro
records.des: "A train's purpose is to run hell for leather," is something you concur with. So, redirect all the power of the weapon, lighting, and air-conditioning systems to the engine.

records.name: Racing Box Turbo
records.des: A train without speed is basically worthless. Anything can be forgone, save for speed.

records.name: Nitro for Speed
records.des: Going full throttle to death's door. It's a shame you can't drift on railway tracks, though.

records.name: Morphic Accelerator
records.des: Makes use of the train's Morphic Field Generator to accelerate the bubbles formed by Morphic Field Pollution. Fairly easy to operate but must be used in severely polluted regions in order to work.

records.name: Skybreaker Drill
records.des: The product of a successful experiment in generating energy with a drill. The louder the user yells, the greater the energy is generated. The previous attempt failed primarily due to the operator's lack of momentum.

records.name: High Interaction Force Shovel
records.des: Ram is considered the most rudimentary method of attack, yet it remains highly effective.

records.name: Hall Maneuver Ram
records.des: Propel the train into high-dimensional space, transforming it into an enormous battering ram capable of crushing even battleships.

records.name: Damascus Battering Ram
records.des: Extraordinary craftsmanship!

records.name: Celestial Fire
records.des: A servo rosary utilized by the Destroyer of the Citadel. When fitted with a lighting device, it can serve as a headlight. Despite its small size, it can easily match the train's speed.

records.name: Magnetic Suspension (Old)
records.des: A new-type suspension system that automatically adjusts the stiffness and damping of the train's suspension, thereby enhancing the stability of the ride.

records.name: Magnetic Suspension
records.des: A new-type suspension system that automatically adjusts the stiffness and damping of the train's suspension, thereby enhancing the stability of the ride.

records.name: This Track that I Soap
records.des: A device used for applying soapy water to the track to enable trains to glide at high speeds. Its invention is said to have been inspired by the bathrooms in the Yunxiu Bridge Reforming Center, although it can result in a loss of control over the brakes.

records.name: Prison Searchlight
records.des: A searchlight installed in prisons that can illuminate a long distance. It has a deterrent effect on those who have served their sentences at Yunxiu Bridge.

Getway.DisplayName: Base Yunxiu Bridge - Yunxiu Bridge Armory

records.name: Police Light
records.des: The police light authorized by BCRL to certain conductors. While this light itself may not be extraordinary, the actions of certain conductors has made it a significant deterrent.

records.name: Yunxiu Bridge Siren
records.des: The siren authorized by BCRL to certain conductors. While this siren itself may not be extraordinary, the actions of certain conductors has made it a significant deterrent.

Getway.DisplayName: Base Yunxiu Bridge - Yunxiu Bridge Armory

records.name: Yunxiu Bridge Coating
records.des: The coating authorized by BCRL to certain conductors. While this paint job itself may not be extraordinary, the actions of certain conductors has inadvertently attracted unwanted attention from robbers.

records.name: Riot Armor
records.des: While this lightweight armor lacks the level of protection offered by the standard B.C.R.L. train armor, it does not hinder train speed.

Getway.DisplayName: Base Yunxiu Bridge - Yunxiu Bridge Armory

records.name: Bulk Central Computer
records.des: The most affordable central computer.

Getway.DisplayName: Base Yunxiu Bridge - Yunxiu Bridge Armory

records.name: Steeltusk
records.des: Me fink dis nevva break duwn. WAAAGH!

records.name: Quiet Glow
records.des: Created using lightwave interference technology, this device produces a ripple effect in light transmission. Hence light creates a soft, wave-like effect in the air, ensuring that the train's headlights do not disrupt anything potentially hazardous during nighttime travel.

records.name: Topological Flower
records.des: Using quantum optics principles, this device creates a stunning kaleidoscopic effect through light interference and diffraction.

records.name: Molta Fourth Movement
records.des: This sonar system serves as both a reconnaissance tool and a device that alters sound waves to weaken targets, making them vulnerable or even causing their destruction.

records.name: Nephas Echo
records.des: This device uses sound reflection to create false echoes and illusions, confusing enemies and creating tactical opportunities for ambushes or escape.

records.name: Mounted 20mm MG
records.des: The standard 20mm machine gun for The Eternal.\nThis equipment is [train weapon] and can be equipped in the train menu.
A test train weapon.\nThis equipment cannot be removed.

records.idCN: 01撞角/00-1蓝-爆炸反应撞击板-消耗
records.name: Explosion Reactive Plate
records.des: Reactive armor always saves the day.\n<color=#FFB800>After 30 rams, this ram will be destroyed.</color>
